capacity.scope: All jobs within cutoff; freshDue is a lower bound of steps for this account, excluding undiscovered objects and other accounts.
capacity.assumptions: One atomic portion per 5-minute Cron, available access/lease/quota; further pages and other accounts increase demand. Deadlines preempt the archive reserve. No production capacity guarantee.
